request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: A unit of the MA STAR two post lift (a vehicle servicing lift) is placed on the market on 1 February 2027. Among which conformity assessment procedures may the manufacturer choose under the act applicable on that day?

response.text:
The lift is covered by Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which applies from 14 January 2027, so it governs a unit placed on the market on 1 February 2027. Vehicle servicing lifts are listed in Annex I, Part A, point 3, and Article 25(2) gives three procedures for that category.

```json
{"kind": "set", "value": ["EU type-examination (module B, Annex VII) followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C, Annex VIII)", "conformity based on full quality assurance (module H, Annex IX)", "conformity based on unit verification (module G, Annex X)"], "text": "Under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which applies from 14 January 2027 (Art. 54), vehicle servicing lifts are listed in Annex I, Part A, point 3, so Article 25(2) applies: the manufacturer may choose module B followed by module C, module H, or module G. The MA STAR two post lift is a vehicle servicing lift, so these are the options for a unit placed on the market on 1 February 2027.", "sources": [{"file": "REG.md", "place": "Art. 25(2)", "quote": "Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Annex I, Part A, point 3", "quote": "3. Vehicle servicing lifts."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Art. 54 Entry into force and application", "quote": "It shall apply from 14 January 2027."}]}
```
